edition.supersedes: none - this is an ADDITIVE addendum to coa-template-2026-08-29.json, merged by family_key upsert + accounts[] append + equity_variants key-merge (see coa-template-addendum-2026-08-29.md SS6)

citations_added_this_pass: MPERS 4.2(n) - current tax liabilities and assets
MPERS 4.2(o) - deferred tax liabilities and assets
MPERS 4.11(a) - PPE subclassification by class appropriate to the entity
MPERS 17.31(d)/(e) - per-class gross carrying amount, accumulated depreciation, reconciliation
MPERS 20.4/20.9/20.11 - finance vs operating lease dual model, 'outstanding liability' not 'lease liability'
MPERS 29.4/29.14 - current tax liability and deferred tax liability recognition
MPERS 33.2(a)(i)/33.9(b)/33.12(g) - director as related party, outstanding-balance disclosure, loans as disclosable transactions
MPERS 6.5(b) - dividends declared and paid or payable
mpers.source: MASB, Malaysian Private Entities Reporting Standard (MPERS), Feb 2016 - extracted directly, fetched 2026-08-29

lhdn_schedule_3.note: Capital allowance RATES are reasoning for why PPE splits by class - see coa-template-addendum-2026-08-29.md SS1.1. Rates are NOT carried as data anywhere in this JSON, per instruction.
lhdn_schedule_3.source: PwC Malaysian Tax Booklet 2024/2025, p.27, fetched 2026-08-29; cross-checked against denpyo.com, ktp.com.my, ey.com.my - one live discrepancy on the ICT-equipment rate flagged in the .md, not resolved silently

cooperative_societies_act_1993.note: Section 57(1)'s statutory reserve fund percentage and Section 57(2)'s trust-fund basis are reasoning for the equity_cooperative family's accounts - the percentage itself is NOT carried as data in this JSON, per instruction, and was not independently primary-source-verified this pass (see .md SS5 item 1).
cooperative_societies_act_1993.source: search-indexed excerpts of Act 502 (skm.gov.my primary PDF resisted text extraction), corroborated across 4 independent queries, fetched 2026-08-29

societies_act_1966.note: Accumulated Fund naming convention - no statutory reserve percentage requirement found (unlike co-operatives).
societies_act_1966.source: Malaysian national Form 5 (SPM) Principles of Accounts curriculum; ROS Form 9 filing convention; real audited society accounts - all search-indexed/fetched 2026-08-29, see .md SS3.1

numbering.scheme: UNCHANGED - extends coa-template-2026-08-29.json's numbering scheme (plain 4-digit codes, one block per account_type). No new numbering decision made this pass.
numbering.rationale: See coa-template-addendum-2026-08-29.md SS4. Codes chosen from unused gaps within each existing block, spaced by 10 for future insertion.

families.label: Property, Plant and Equipment (General)
families.basis: MPERS 4.2(e); MPERS 4.11(a) and 17.31(d)/(e) require per-class disclosure of gross cost and accumulated depreciation - a single PPE line cannot satisfy this

families.label: Owner-Occupied Land and Buildings
families.basis: MPERS 4.2(e) - split from the core PPE-by-class family because most Malaysian SMEs rent their premises (see core premises_and_admin family) rather than own the land/building they operate from

families.label: Borrowings and Lease Liabilities
families.basis: MPERS 4.2(m) financial liabilities; MPERS 20.4/20.9/20.11 for the finance-lease 'outstanding liability' terminology (MPERS keeps the pre-MFRS16 finance/operating lease dual model); hire-purchase creditor + interest-suspense is a genuinely distinct Malaysian SME liability class from a bank term loan (coa-template-addendum-2026-08-29.md SS1.4)

families.label: Current and Deferred Tax
families.basis: MPERS 4.2(n)/(o); MPERS 29.4 (current tax liability recognition) and 29.14 (deferred tax liability recognition) are unconditional recognition requirements, not disclosure-only

families.label: Provisions
families.basis: MPERS 4.2(p); MPERS Section 21's own recognition test scopes this to when a present obligation exists - not every entity has one. Lower-priority addition, included at minimum (one generic account) to satisfy the letter of 4.2(p)

families.label: Director and Related Party Balances
families.basis: MPERS 33.2(a)(i) (director as key management personnel = related party); 33.9(b) (outstanding-balance disclosure); 33.12(g) (loans as a named disclosable transaction class). Routine Malaysian Sdn Bhd practice, confirmed via a real AutoCount client export naming a director's current account

families.label: Equity - Society
families.basis: firm practice per Malaysian convention (Societies Act 1966 context) - 'Accumulated Fund' confirmed via the national Form 5 (SPM) Principles of Accounts curriculum and ROS Form 9 filing convention, not a single regulatory pronouncement (coa-template-addendum-2026-08-29.md SS3.1). NOTE: the core equity_common family's 'Retained Earnings' label is imperfect for a society - a named, unresolved gap, see known_gaps below

families.label: Equity - Co-operative
families.basis: Co-operative Societies Act 1993 (Act 502) s.2 (Share/Syer definition - 'Share Capital' is the Act's own term); s.57(1) (Statutory Reserve Fund, a graduated rate - NOT carried as a number in this JSON, see coa-template-addendum-2026-08-29.md SS3.2 and SS5 item 1 for the primary-source-verification caveat); s.57(2) (Co-operative Education/Development Trust Funds, rate set by Ministerial determination, not fixed in the Act)

families.label: Entertainment (Tax-Split)
families.basis: ITA 1967 s.39(1)(l)/s.18; PR 4/2015 (50% restriction, 8 named 100%-deductible exceptions). RECLASSIFIED from opt_in to core this pass - Q8's ruling is that tax-sensitive expenses land automatically for every client; any client-facing business incurs entertainment costs at some point (coa-template-addendum-2026-08-29.md SS2)

families.label: Donations - Approved Institutions (Tax-Split)
families.basis: ITA 1967 s.44(6) - deductible to the Government/State/local authority without cap, or to a DGIR-approved institution up to 10% of aggregate income. RECLASSIFIED from opt_in to core this pass - corporate giving is common enough across Malaysian SMEs and the account costs nothing unused (coa-template-addendum-2026-08-29.md SS2)

families.label: Donations - Unapproved / Non-Deductible (Tax-Split)
families.basis: ITA 1967 s.44(6) by omission - not within the approved mechanism, non-deductible. RECLASSIFIED from opt_in to core this pass - paired with donations_approved; a firm cannot know in advance which bucket a donation lands in without both accounts present (coa-template-addendum-2026-08-29.md SS2)

families.label: Fines and Penalties (Tax-Split)
families.basis: ITA 1967 s.39(1) read with s.33(1); case law (Aspac Lubricants (M) Sdn Bhd v KPHDN) - no dedicated Public Ruling. RECLASSIFIED from opt_in to core this pass - near-universal, a traffic summons alone makes this likely for any business with a vehicle or premises (coa-template-addendum-2026-08-29.md SS2)

families.label: Depreciation and Amortisation (Tax-Split)
families.basis: ITA 1967 s.39(1)(k) disallows book depreciation; s.19 + Schedule 3 substitute capital allowances; PR 12/2014, PR 6/2015. RECLASSIFIED from opt_in to core this pass - universal, and this addendum alone adds a full PPE-by-class section, so every business with any capitalised asset needs this account (coa-template-addendum-2026-08-29.md SS2)

families.label: Doubtful Debts and Unapproved Provisions (Tax-Split)
families.basis: ITA 1967 s.34(2); PR 4/2019 (replaces PR 1/2002) - a specific provision is deductible, a general provision is not; s.39(1)(c) for unapproved pension/provident fund contributions. RECLASSIFIED from opt_in to core this pass - trade_receivables (the account this pairs against) is itself core; nearly every business extends some credit and eventually risks a bad debt (coa-template-addendum-2026-08-29.md SS2)

families.label: Private and Proprietor's Expenses (Tax-Split)
families.basis: ITA 1967 s.39(1)(a) - domestic/private expenditure - no dedicated Public Ruling. RE-KEYED this pass from a blank opt_in to entity_types: [sole_prop, partnership] - genuinely entity-type-conditional; the account exists to catch a sole proprietor's or partner's personal expenses run through the business. A Sdn Bhd's equivalent case (a director's personal spending) is caught instead by the new director_and_related_party_balances family (coa-template-addendum-2026-08-29.md SS1.7, SS2)

accounts.notes: contra-asset

accounts.name: Accumulated Depreciation - Computer and ICT Equipment
accounts.notes: contra-asset

accounts.name: Renovation and Leasehold Improvements
accounts.notes: a real balance-sheet PPE class even though structural renovation mostly gets NO capital allowance under Schedule 3 - only severable fixtures within it qualify as plant (dossier SS1.1)

accounts.name: Accumulated Depreciation - Renovation and Leasehold Improvements
accounts.notes: contra-asset

accounts.name: Freehold Land
accounts.notes: not depreciated - indefinite useful life under standard practice

accounts.name: Accumulated Depreciation - Buildings
accounts.notes: contra-asset

accounts.name: Accumulated Amortisation - Computer Software
accounts.notes: contra-asset

accounts.name: Goodwill
accounts.notes: arises only on a business combination/acquisition

accounts.name: Bank Overdraft
accounts.notes: repayable on demand - distinct in nature from a term loan

accounts.name: Hire Purchase Creditor
accounts.notes: purchase price plus total HP interest; paired with 2440's interest-in-suspense contra

accounts.name: Hire Purchase Interest Suspense
accounts.notes: contra-liability - unaccrued HP interest, released to the P&L as it accrues

accounts.name: Finance Lease Obligation
accounts.notes: scoped only to arrangements passing MPERS 20.4's finance-lease test - MPERS does not use an MFRS16-style blanket lease-liability model (dossier SS1.4)

accounts.name: Provisions
accounts.notes: generic - recognised only when a present obligation genuinely exists per MPERS Section 21

accounts.name: Amount Due to Director(s)
accounts.notes: one of the first ledgers reviewed in an LHDN audit per Malaysian practitioner guidance (dossier SS1.7)

accounts.name: Dividends Payable
accounts.notes: declared-but-unpaid dividend - distinct from 3800 Dividends Paid (the equity distribution account); added to the EXISTING equity_company family, no new family (dossier SS1.8)

accounts.name: Accumulated Fund
accounts.notes: the society equivalent of Retained Earnings - the core equity_common family's 3900 Retained Earnings label is imperfect for a society entity_type, a named unresolved gap - see known_gaps

accounts.name: Entrance / Registration Fees
accounts.notes: some societies credit this directly to the Accumulated Fund as capital income instead - a firm-level policy choice, not resolved here (dossier SS3.1)

accounts.name: Share Capital (Members' Shares)
accounts.notes: 'Share Capital' is the Co-operative Societies Act 1993 s.2's own term ('Syer')

accounts.name: Statutory Reserve Fund
accounts.notes: mandated by Act 502 s.57(1), graduated rate - see dossier SS3.2 and SS5 item 1 for the primary-source-verification caveat; the rate itself is NOT stored in this JSON

accounts.name: Co-operative Education Trust Fund Payable
accounts.notes: mandated by Act 502 s.57(2); contribution rate set by Ministerial determination, not fixed in the Act

accounts.name: Co-operative Development Trust Fund Payable
accounts.notes: mandated by Act 502 s.57(2); contribution rate set by Ministerial determination, not fixed in the Act

accounts.name: Dividend Payable to Members
accounts.notes: 'Dividen' is distinct in Malaysian co-op practice from a discretionary 'Bonus' payment - see dossier SS3.2

accounts.name: Private and Proprietor's Expenses
accounts.notes: UNCHANGED account (already existed at this code in coa-template-2026-08-29.json) - listed here only because its PARENT FAMILY's inclusion/entity_types changed this pass (see families[] above); the build lane should treat this as a no-op on accounts[], the family upsert is what matters

known_gaps: SOCIETY LABEL COLLISION, unresolved: the core equity_common family's 3900 Retained Earnings applies unconditionally (a core family cannot carry entity_type trim keys). For a society, 'Retained Earnings' is the wrong term entirely (a non-profit does not retain distributable earnings) - the correct concept is 3040 Accumulated Fund, added here as an opt_in addition. A society applying the standard template today gets BOTH accounts, one mislabeled for its entity type. Whether to rename/retire 3900 for a society at apply time, or leave both for a human to tidy, is a build-lane mechanism decision NOT resolved by this research pass.

Act 502 s.57(1)'s graduated 25%/15% statutory reserve fund percentage was NOT independently verified against a directly-readable primary source this pass (every primary PDF mirror attempted resisted text extraction) - re-verify against the gazetted text before citing formally. The percentage is not stored anywhere in this JSON regardless.

SKM's own GP23 guideline (Garis Panduan Pelaporan Penyata Kewangan Koperasi) - likely the single best authoritative source for a Malaysian co-operative's chart of accounts - was not readable this pass (PDF text extraction failed). Recommended first read if this template is revisited for co-operative clients.

Sage UBS's and NCL's actual PPE-by-class and borrowings/HP account naming was not independently confirmed this pass - the evidence in families property_plant_equipment_general and borrowings_and_lease_liabilities rests primarily on a real AutoCount client export plus Bukku's and Million System's documentation, corroborated by a Slideshare document of unconfirmed vendor-official status.

The ICT-equipment capital allowance rate (20% vs 40% annual allowance) shows a live discrepancy across secondary sources for YA2026 specifically - resolved against the primary PwC table in the .md but not independently confirmed against current LHDN guidance. This does not affect any value stored in this JSON.
